title: b7z9.22.2: Rust tx_allowed: accept slot_map array instead of single slot
description: Modify tdma_clock.rs tx_allowed() to accept a slot_map (&[u8]) and check if the current slot index is in the map, instead of checking a single derived slot. Current function (tdma_clock.rs:69-80) only checks timing within one slot window. The slot_map comes from the parsed beacon. Update callers. Add unit tests covering multi-slot and empty-map cases.
